Main.dc.html.title: Character creator v1a · Guided steps: one step per screen, hex pips along the top. Swatches, heads and hairstyles are placeholders; the mini is a stand-in for the 3D model

Creator-v1b-PaintingTable.dc.html.title: Character creator v1b · Painting table: the mini on a worktable, tool trays in any order, paint pots for colours. Same placeholders as v1a

Creator-v1c-OriginBoard.dc.html.title: Character creator v1c · Origin board: class, ancestry and background are hex tiles placed around the mini; tap a placed tile to finish its details. Same placeholders as v1a

Creator-v2a-ClassTiles.dc.html.title: Character creator v2a · Class step: bigger class hexes on top, the picked class's blurb, main scores, gear and level-1 kit below. God is its own step after Class (Clerics only). Steps after God are as in v1a

Creator-v2b-ClassList.dc.html.title: Character creator v2b · Class step: classes as a full-height list, details on the right with Back and Next inside them (like level-up v9b). God step and later steps as in v2a

Creator-v2c-ClassCards.dc.html.title: Character creator v2c · Class step: six class cards with main scores and level-1 kit; tapping one opens the level-up style pop-up over the mini with Choose. God step and later steps as in v2a

Creator-v3-ClassSpacing.dc.html.title: Character creator v3 · v2a with spacing fixed: no title row (the pips name the step), smaller class hexes, the blurb on one line, facts and level-1 kit side by side, casters' spell slots without a repeat line

Creator-v4a-FullScreen.dc.html.title: Character creator v4a · Full-screen choices: no mini until Look. Class and God are hanging banners across the whole screen; the picked one widens and reveals its blurb, facts and level-1 kit. The mini rises in at Look. Banner colours (each class's quest terrain, each god's terrain) are placeholders

Creator-v4b-Legend.dc.html.title: Character creator v4b · The legend: no mini until Look. A parchment page on the left writes the hero's legend as you pick (class blurb, god, race and trait, background and starting place, then scores, proficiencies, gear and spells). At Look the mini rises in its place

Creator-v5a-Stitched.dc.html.title: Character creator v5a · Stitched: v4a's banners with the details sewn straight onto the cloth (no white card). A stitched line under the name, main scores as hex badges, facts on the left, a stitched seam, then the level-1 kit

Creator-v5b-Patches.dc.html.title: Character creator v5b · Patches: the details as sewn-on cloth patches in a shade of the banner (main scores, armour, weapons, level-1 kit), each with a stitched edge

Creator-v5c-Heraldry.dc.html.title: Character creator v5c · Heraldry: a centred crest (emblem, name, blurb), a stitched divider, main-score badges beside weapons and armour, and the level-1 card hanging from the banner's tip like a charm (its effect text isn't shown)

Creator-v6-CardDetails.dc.html.title: Character creator v6 · v5c chosen, with card details: tap the hanging level-1 card (or a god's free spell) to open a pop-up above it, in the level-up pop-up style, with what it does, its AP and any use limit. Tap again or the X to close. Spell slots stay plain

Creator-v7a-SubInBanner.dc.html.title: Character creator v7a · Race step, sub-types in the banner: picking a race widens its banner; a row of sub-type pills sits under the blurb (dragon types in their colours), and picking one swaps in its name, blurb and trait. The racial card hangs from the tip. Race emblems and colours are placeholders

Creator-v7b-SubStep.dc.html.title: Character creator v7b · Race step, then its own sub-type step: the race banners show the race blurb, boosts and the sub-types to come; a Sub-type / Dragon type / Bloodline pip follows Race (skipped for Humans and Halflings) with its own banners, blurbs, traits and racial card

Creator-v7c-Pennants.dc.html.title: Character creator v7c · Race step, sub-types as pennants: picking a race hangs a rod of small pennants across its banner's foot (dragon types in their colours); the picked one drops lower and glows, and its blurb and trait fill the banner. The racial card hangs from the same rod

Creator-v8a-SubHexes.dc.html.title: Character creator v8a · v7a chosen. Racial passives are blue-rimmed icon hexes (like the Lady of the Lake's) beside the boosts; tap for a pop-up. Sub-types are hex tokens strung on the stitched line (dragon types in their colours); the picked one gets the orange rim and gold glow. A coloured sub-type recolours the banner. Passive names for wood elf, dwarves, metal golem and tieflings are working names

Creator-v8b-SubTabs.dc.html.title: Character creator v8b · Same passives as v8a; sub-types are cloth tabs along the banner's top edge under the rod. Unpicked tabs sit tucked in a darker shade (dragon types in their colours); the picked one merges into the banner with a gold underline

Creator-v9-RacePolish.dc.html.title: Character creator v9 · v8a chosen and polished: dragon types and the Breath Weapon card use element icons (fire, lightning, cold, acid, poison); the Dragonborn banner is slate until a type is picked; rows only hold what they show, so boosts and passives sit centred; high elves pick 1 of 3 elven spells from cards hanging off the banner (blue band, tick on the pick); tieflings get their bloodline spell beside the racial card

Creator-v10-TieflingSpells.dc.html.title: Character creator v10 · v9 with the tiefling change: Burn It Down, From the Ashes and Hearthfire are now their bloodlines' level-7 spells, so a new tiefling shows only its level-1 bloodline spell (Scorch, Ember Mend or Guiding Ember)

Creator-v11a-VerticalNames.dc.html.title: Character creator v11a · Narrow banners name themselves top to bottom down the cloth, so any length fits (class, god and race steps). Shorter Tiefling blurb, now on one line

Creator-v11b-WiderNarrow.dc.html.title: Character creator v11b · Narrow banners widen from 50 to 60px so names fit at 10px. Trade-off: the picked banner loses 70px, so the Human and Tiefling blurbs wrap again and the Tiefling's bottom row is clipped. Shorter Tiefling blurb

Creator-v12-Background.dc.html.title: Character creator v12 · Background step as banners (on v11a): six banners in their background terrain's colour; the picked one shows a large starting-place hex tile as its crest (stand-in for the starting hex's art), then the name, the new blurb and its starting place. Proficiencies stay in the Skills step

Creator-v13-NamedPlaces.dc.html.title: Character creator v13 · v12 with named starting places (Dunfaire Tower, East Rime Chapel, Monto Town, Sternbrunn Spire, The Oak & Lantern, Weizenhof Estate) and unique icons: a wizard tower for the Sage, an inn with a hanging sign, a manor for the Noble's estate. Icons are stand-ins for the tiles' art

Creator-v14a-OnBanners.dc.html.title: Character creator v14a · Picks on the banners: no Scores or Skills steps. Tap 2 boost badges on the Race banner and 1 main score on the Class banner (+1 tags appear); the class and background proficiency choices hang from those banners' tips (Pick 1 proficiency). Also fixes class and god banners' missing weapons, armour and divider since v9

Creator-v14b-Stones.dc.html.title: Character creator v14b · Ability stones: Scores is a wooden board of six ability hexes with coins; tap a +1 token (Race ×2, Class ×1) in the tray, then a glowing stone (dots show which stones each token can go on); tap a placed +1 to take it back. Skills shows the stones again with each proficiency hanging under its base ability (background pills sand, class pills orange)

Creator-v14c-AbilityBanners.dc.html.title: Character creator v14c · Ability banners: six banners, one per ability (placeholder colours), showing value and coins; the +1 tokens sit between Back and Next and pin onto the banners. Skills shortens the banners and hangs each proficiency under its base ability

Creator-v14d-Training.dc.html.title: Character creator v14d · One Training step: Scores and Skills merge into one banner: the six abilities with coins on top, then race and class +1 picks side by side, then the background and class proficiency picks as icon hexes with their base ability. A rank-2 tag appears if both picks match

Creator-v15a-LevelUpTiles.dc.html.title: Character creator v15a · Level-up tiles: banners end after Background; Scores and Skills switch to the level-up screen's look. A who-you-are card on the left (class emblem, race and class, background and starting place). Scores: six large coin tiles (as level-up v8d) with +1 Race / +1 Class chips on the scores each can go on, counters with dot-to-tick marks on top. Skills: the feat step's list and details panel (v9b): background and class proficiencies in two groups, details show checks, base, signature effect and Choose

Creator-v15b-AbilityDetails.dc.html.title: Character creator v15b · Ability details: like v15a, but Scores also uses the list and details panel. Tap an ability row to see what it's for (its proficiencies, spellcasting, weapons) and add the race or class +1 there; a note says why one can't go on it. Skills as v15a

Creator-v15c-TrainingPopups.dc.html.title: Character creator v15c · One Training step in the level-up look: the six score tiles with +1 chips on top, the background and class proficiencies below as named icon hexes; tapping one opens the level-up pop-up over the who-you-are card with Choose
